name: Perst
tagline: McObject's embedded object database for Java and .NET, dual-licensed GPL or commercial.
description: Perst is an object-oriented embedded database from McObject, with an all-Java edition and a C# edition for .NET. Objects are persisted transparently and indexed with a wide choice of structures (B-trees, R-trees, KD-trees, Patricia tries and more), and it includes full-text search and a small SQL subset called JSQL. Its pitch is a tiny footprint for Java SE, Android and .NET apps that want object persistence without an ORM. McObject still offers downloads and commercial licenses, but the product sees little visible development and its community is small next to SQLite or ObjectBox.
statusNote: Still sold by McObject, but no public version history or recent releases are documented on its product page.

pricing.notes: Free under GPL; closed-source products need a commercial license from McObject.

strengths: Transparent persistence of plain Java or .NET objects
Unusually broad index types, including spatial R-trees and KD-trees
Small footprint suitable for embedded and Android use
weaknesses: GPL licensing forces a commercial license for most proprietary apps
Small community and sparse modern documentation
Little evidence of active feature development
useCases: Embedded Java or .NET apps needing object persistence
Devices needing spatial indexes in a tiny footprint
notIdealFor: New projects wanting an active ecosystem
